operator-004.*: semantic-note: integer / integer is emitted unchanged, so the result type is backend semantics (plan 3.3): integer division on PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite, exact NUMBER division on Oracle, DOUBLE on Databricks.

operator-012.SqlServer: semantic-note: || becomes +, so NULL propagation follows CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL (ON in every supported configuration).

order-page-001.*: semantic-note: the default null ordering is backend semantics (plan 3.3); the emitter injects no NULLS FIRST/LAST.

order-page-005.SqlServer: semantic-note: ASC NULLS FIRST is the native T-SQL ordering, so the clause is omitted.

order-page-008.SqlServer: semantic-note: DESC NULLS LAST is the native T-SQL ordering, so the clause is omitted.

select-024.Oracle: semantic-note: LIKE is case-sensitive (the session NLS_COMP/NLS_SORT is pinned by the gateway).
select-024.SqlServer: semantic-note: LIKE follows the column collation (usually case-insensitive).

literal-013.Oracle: semantic-note: the empty string is NULL in Oracle, so the bound '' is NULL (SEC-ADG-17).

complex-018.Oracle: semantic-note: NULLIF(a, '') compares with NULL on Oracle because '' is NULL (SEC-ADG-17).

literal-021.SqlServer: semantic-note: the boolean literal is emitted as the integer 1 (no boolean type).
literal-021.Sqlite: semantic-note: the boolean literal is emitted as the integer 1 (no boolean type).
literal-021.Oracle: semantic-note: the boolean literal is emitted as the integer 1 (no SQL boolean in SELECT lists).

fn-string-009.Oracle: KNOWN-GAP: Oracle CONCAT takes exactly two arguments; the three-argument form is emitted unchanged and fails at execution.

fn-string-010.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: SUBSTR is not a T-SQL function; the call is emitted unchanged and fails at execution.

fn-string-011.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: SUBSTR is not a T-SQL function; the call is emitted unchanged and fails at execution.

fn-string-012.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: SUBSTRING needs three arguments in T-SQL; the two-argument form fails at execution.
fn-string-012.Oracle: KNOWN-GAP: Oracle has no SUBSTRING function (SUBSTR); the call is emitted unchanged and fails at execution.

fn-string-017.PostgreSql: KNOWN-GAP: the two-argument REPLACE does not exist on PostgreSQL; it fails at execution.
fn-string-017.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: the two-argument REPLACE does not exist in T-SQL; it fails at execution.

fn-string-018.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: LPAD does not exist in T-SQL; the call is emitted unchanged and fails at execution.

fn-string-019.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: RPAD does not exist in T-SQL; the call is emitted unchanged and fails at execution.

fn-string-051.SqlServer: KNOWN-GAP: OCTET_LENGTH does not exist in T-SQL (DATALENGTH); it fails at execution.
fn-string-051.Oracle: KNOWN-GAP: OCTET_LENGTH does not exist in Oracle (LENGTHB); it fails at execution.

fn-string-052.Oracle: KNOWN-GAP: CHAR_LENGTH does not exist in Oracle (LENGTH); it fails at execution.

fn-string-053.Oracle: KNOWN-GAP: CHARACTER_LENGTH does not exist in Oracle (LENGTH); it fails at execution.

fn-math-013.Oracle: KNOWN-GAP: Oracle has no LOG10 function (LOG(10, x)); it fails at execution.

setop-010.*: KNOWN-DEFECT: parenthesized query terms in a set operation make the AST builder throw InvalidCastException instead of a typed rejection (fail closed, wrong error type).
